title: The Renewal Window (Part 2)
description: Patricia finally reaches the window. They hand her the pen. Now she's on the other side of the counter, and Doreen is free to go renew her permit. Barry, somehow, is calling in from inside the office. He's almost through page one.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Snazzie FM. When we left, Patricia had one applicant ahead of her... the building. Patricia, are you at the window?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I'm at the window, Ronnie. <p:0.3> Doreen just slid me a pen.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A pen. That's wonderful. They're letting you sign.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: No, Ronnie. They're letting me work the window. <p:0.4> Doreen says I'm the clerk now.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: You filled out enough forms, hon. <p:0.3> Eventually they put you on the other side. <p:0.3> I told you that.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: But I came to renew a permit, Doreen!

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: And now I'm going to, hon. <p:0.4> I took a number this morning. <p:0.3> I'm finally next.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Hold on. Doreen, you're stepping away from the counter?

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: I'm a customer now, hon. <p:0.3> Patricia's got the window. <p:0.3> Be patient with her, she's new.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Patricia. Patricia, it's Barry. I'm inside.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Inside where, Barry?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The office! I came to pull you OUT. <p:0.3> I walked in, I took one number, and now I'm sitting down.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry, you went in after her. <p:0.3> That's a rescue. How far have you gotten?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm... almost through page one.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Oh no, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It's fine! Page one's the easy part! It just wants my name and the date of my... oh.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: There's a little red star, isn't there, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: There's a little red star.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Estimate it, hon. <p:0.3> Keep the line moving.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Don't you tell me to estimate it, Doreen! You're a CUSTOMER now! You don't get to say hon!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Barry, pull a number for section nine.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Don't YOU say it either!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It's required, Barry! <p:0.3> The stack only gets taller!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Then STOP processing me!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I can't, the screen does it!

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Little red star.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Doreen, you reached the window. <p:0.4> You're renewing. So what's behind the counter?

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Another window, hon. <p:0.4> And a very patient lady at it. <p:0.3> She just handed me a pen.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're gonna take a break before someone hands ME a pen. <p:0.3> Barry, when you reach the window... let us out.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm not taking a number.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: You already did, hon. <p:0.4> You're almost through page one.
